answer: Rank agents with SybilRank-style short random walks. Trust starts on a few audited seed agents and spreads through attestation edges for only log(n) steps, like pigment dropped into an orchard's irrigation: it saturates the honest, densely linked region before it can leak into a farm. Sybils can mint an ocean of keys, but few honest agents attest them, so trust per key in that cluster stays tiny and their rewards and votes stay tiny too.
